newsitem.title: USA: Trigon says Labor Dept concludes inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Trigon says Labor Dept concludes inquiry.

text.p: Trigon Healthcare Inc said on Friday that the U.S. Department of Labor is not taking further action after its inquiry into the way the company negotiated hospital discounts for its healthcare plans.

In a letter received today, the Labor Department advised Trigon that no further action is presently contemplated regarding Trigon's role as a service provider to Employee Retirement Income Security Act covered self-funded health benefit plans, Trigon said.
Trigon said it has cooperated fully with the Department of Labor and provided additional facts to the department.
